A Story Worth Knowing

Where ambition meets
quiet confidence

Born under the summer skies of Ahmedabad, I am a person of rare conviction — someone who moves through the world with purpose, warmth, and an unmistakable sense of self. A Brahmin by heritage, Trivedi Mevada by lineage, I carry the depth of tradition alongside an appetite for the contemporary.

At 27, I have built a life that reflects my character: driven yet grounded, cultured yet curious, competitive yet deeply human. I believe that true success is not merely what you achieve, but who you become in the pursuit of it.

The Man Behind the Name

A life lived fully, intentionally,
and in motion!

🏓

The Sportsman & The Disciplined

Cricket, snooker, swimming, and the gym define my leisure as much as my professional life. From the pitch to the pool, a competitive spirit and a commitment to physical excellence shape everything I do. I believe mastery of oneself is where all achievement truly begins.

✈️

The Traveller & The Thinker

Every journey is a new chapter and the finest teacher I know. Travel broadens perspective, sharpens taste, and reveals dimensions of the world that no classroom can offer. Alongside that curiosity, I read voraciously about business, entrepreneurship, and markets — building my own curriculum beyond any formal degree.

📈

The Strategist & The Visionary

Science-trained yet commercially driven, I have a rare mind that bridges disciplines. Snooker taught me patience, precision, and foresight — qualities I bring equally to the boardroom. I think three moves ahead, always, with a clear vision for what comes next.

"An ambitious spirit, a curious mind,
and a heart rooted in family"

On what defines me
The Journey So Far
Schooling

Nirman High School

My formative years at Nirman High School laid a disciplined intellectual foundation. Choosing the Science stream reflected an early commitment to rigorous thinking, analytical depth, and the pursuit of understanding how the world truly works.

Education

Bachelor of Engineering in Computer

A rigorous technical education gave me an analytical mind — one I would later apply with engineering precision to the art of management and business leadership. The degree was a beginning, not a ceiling.

Designation

General Manager

At an age when many are still finding their footing, I lead with authority and clarity as General Manager — overseeing teams, strategy, and operations with the steady hand of earned experience and genuine care for people.

Ambition

Beyond the Degree

Refusing to be confined by a single discipline, I have independently cultivated deep knowledge in commerce, entrepreneurship, and market dynamics. My education never stopped — it simply moved beyond the classroom.

Today

₹16 Lakhs Annual Income

A testament to trajectory — and only the beginning. My career is not just a profession; it is a vocation pursued with passion, discipline, and an unshakeable vision for the future.
